description: Read one canonical backfill job for this exact provider and its terminal result/error. Returns raw stored status; execution_measured is false and an advisory distinguishes a processing row from measured live execution. Never performs credential/HTTP/whole-ledger work, mutates job history or starts/retries/resumes work. A bounded lifecycle tick records interrupted jobs. After worker_interrupted or partial ingest, submit a fresh force=True backfill_from_cloud request; this is independent work, not resume.
embedding_description: Poll a canonical asynchronous cloud backfill job_id for stored queued/processing/completed/error status and terminal payload without starting work. Retains accepted requests and persisted events; interrupted work needs an explicit fresh forced retry, with no automatic replay or public cancellation.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: job_id, raw stored status, execution_measured false, advisory; completed includes result and error includes error payload.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report stored status and terminal payload accurately. Do not claim a worker is alive from processing alone. After interruption/partial failure describe retained requests and ingest effects, then use a fresh explicit force=True backfill if requested. Busy admission accepted no job. No automatic continuation, public cancel/resume, atomic idempotent successor or cross-host fencing is supplied.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: invalid_job_id requires a canonical nonempty job id. backfill_status_failed means the ledger read failed or the job belongs to a different provider; it does not assert an empty history.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use the canonical job_id returned by this plugin backfill_from_cloud. Preserve any read error and retry polling after restoring ledger access. Polling never repairs or rewrites history.
